directive_events.owner_directive: Manager dispatch plan: 9 agents in 4 waves. Wave 1 A1 CORE (registry+discovery+spawn+MCP strategies, blocking). Wave 2a A2 API, A3 ENGINE, A4 FE-CONTRACT in parallel. Wave 2b A5 FE-UI then A6 LAYOUT. Wave 3 A7 TESTS then A8 DOCS. Wave 4 A9 no-context audit. Write sets are disjoint; SetupScreen.tsx owned solely by A5, BottomPanel/TerminalTabs solely by A6.

Owner reviewed both protected-core diffs and authorized admin-approved:core-change for src/scistudio/engine/pty_control.py (FR-010 PtyTabSpec.provider) and src/scistudio/blocks/ai/ai_block.py (FR-012 removal of _build_spawn_argv, _BYPASS_FLAG, _discover_provider). Owner applies the label to the final PR; CI verifies actor provenance.

owner authorized skipping the local PR-wrapper preflight. Owner stated the Windows failures are known. CI remains the authoritative evaluator and runs the full evaluator on Linux with pinned tool versions.
